![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14186989/assets/635de7075b0d106ffc2a0f15e65ca7a3406a49945591aa5eae59090c74df1398.png)

Due to the symmetry of the student's $t$-distribution, we have that $P(|X|\ge x)=0.01$ is equivalent to

$$
2P(X\ge x)=0.01\,⟹\,P(X\ge x)=0.005.
$$

Now, since $X∼{T}_{19},$ we focus on the row of the table that corresponds to $k=19.$

| $k∖p$ | $0.100$ | $0.050$ | $0.025$ | $0.010$ | $0.005$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $19$ | $1.328$ | $1.729$ | $2.093$ | $2.539$ | $2.861$ |
| $20$ | $1.325$ | $1.725$ | $2.086$ | $2.528$ | $2.845$ |
| $21$ | $1.323$ | $1.721$ | $2.080$ | $2.518$ | $2.831$ |

From this row, we see that

$$
P(X\ge 2.861)=0.005.
$$

Therefore, our answer is $x=2.861.$

2P(X≥x)=0.01⟹P(X≥x)=0.005.

Now, since X∼T19, we focus on the row of the table that corresponds to k=19.

k∖p 0.100 0.050 0.025 0.010 0.005
19 1.328 1.729 2.093 2.539 2.861
20 1.325 1.725 2.086 2.528 2.845
21 1.323 1.721 2.080 2.518 2.831

From this row, we see that P(X≥2.861)=0.005.

Therefore, our answer is x=2.861.
